name: 1942_stalingrad
title: Battle of Stalingrad, Sept 1942
notes: Battle of Stalingrad, 13-26 Sep 1942 (the decisive city-center phase). The 6. Armee's LI. Korps assault (von Seydlitz) against Chuikov's 62. Armiya, researched (Glantz & House 'Armageddon in Stalingrad' via German Wikipedia citations + lexikon-der-wehrmacht + en/ru Wikipedia unit pages). AXES: the city's German-held W/NW/SW approaches (the Volga is the E edge); dirs=NW (the northern factory axis, Gorodishche-Orlovka) + SW (the south-city axis, Tsaritsa-Minina) mirror the 13 Sep three-prong: center (71. + 295. ID against the city center and Mamayev Kurgan), south (24. PzDiv + 94. ID to the Tsaritsa mouth and grain elevator), north (389. ID + 14. PzDiv toward the tractor works). ATTACKER (78 bns): 71. ID (weakest, 8 bns org 35 - III./IR 191 dissolved, 300-400 men per bn on the 14 Sep census), 295. ID (org 40, III. bns 35), 94. ID (IR 267 at 35 after the elevator), 389. ID (fresh Sturm-Div, org 55), 24. PzDiv (Pz.Rgt. 24 down to 14-34 tanks, XXXXVIII PzK until 15 Sep), 14. PzDiv (Pz.Rgt. 36 ~20 tanks, XIV PzK), the LI/XIV Korps assault pioneers Pi.Btl. 50/162 (org 70, the Sturm-Pionier pool), StuG.Abt. 244/245 (StuG III F L/43) and the 9. Flak-Division's 88mm (piercing 100 - the best AT in the city, requested by 94. ID at the grain elevator). 1942 equipment: Pz.III 50mm L/42 mix (armor 50/piercing 65 - cannot frontally pen the T-34), StuG/88 only tank-killers. DEFENDER (91 bns): 13. GvSD (Rodimtsev, crossed 14/15 Sep, org 55 - 34/39/42 Gv.SP, the Pavlov House in 42 Gv.SP's 3rd bn), 95. SD (Gorishny, 17/18 Sep, org 50), 112. SD (Ermolkin, in the city since 7-12 Sep, org 40), 284. SD (Batyuk, 20-22 Sep, org 50 - 1043/1045/1047 SP), 193. SD (Smekhotvorov, 21-27 Sep, org 45), 10. NKVD Div (Saraev, 269/270/272/282 SP, org 55-70), the 124. OSBR with the 32. Volga-Flotilla Marine Bn (Gorokhov group), 115. OSBR (org 25), 92. Morskaya Strelkovaya Brigada (naval, org 30), 99./189. TB + the Stalingrad Proletariat tank brigade (60 STZ factory T-34s), STZ/Barrikady/Red October workers militia (org 25), 20. IPTABR (76mm ZiS-3 + 45mm), 92 Gv. Mortar Rgt (Katyusha), 1077 ZAP (the STZ AA regiment). EXCLUDED: 76. ID (VIII. Korps - Kotluban corridor, never the city center, Glantz p.741), 100. Jaeger (arrived 26 Sep for the kurgan relief - after the assault window), 308. SD (crossed the Volga 1/2 Oct), 37./39. GvSD + 88 Gv. heavy tank rgt (October), 60./3. ID(mot) + 29. ID(mot) + 16. PzDiv + 384./79./113. ID (corridor/flanks), Pi.Rgt. 672 and sArt.Abt. 849 (unverifiable). Division composition follows the P2 ruling: no pure-artillery divisions - every gun/AA/AT rides a line division, every division is a full battlegroup. Stats = 1941 calibration (soft 9/def 28 infantry), armor re-calibrated for 1942 (T-34 80/81 kept; Pz.III mix 50/65; StuG F 50/92; 88mm 100). AI plays urban_defense (the city is held street by street - the historical outcome where the assault grinds and the 62. Armiya does not break; the Sept-Oct German gains reached ~90% of the city, the campaign was decided by the Volga bridgehead and Uranus, not by this fight).
